imageAlt: KonnexPlay Is Now Integrated with KheloMore
paragraphs:
Your sports venue deserves to be discovered by more players. Now, managing those bookings just got easier.
We're excited to announce that KonnexPlay has successfully completed its integration with KheloMore, one of India's growing sports discovery and venue booking platforms.
For sports venue owners, this means a new opportunity to reach more players through KheloMore while continuing to manage their venue bookings and availability through KonnexPlay.
Whether you run a pickleball court, badminton facility, football turf, box cricket arena, or a multi-sport venue, the idea is simple: make your venue easier to discover, bring in more bookings, and spend less time managing them.
Why This Integration Matters for Sports Venue Owners
Running a sports venue isn't just about maintaining good courts or offering a great playing experience. It's also about making sure players can find your venue when they're looking for somewhere to play.
And today, that search increasingly happens online.
Players want to check available slots, compare venues, and book their preferred playing time without making phone calls or waiting for WhatsApp replies.
This is where KheloMore comes in.
KheloMore helps sports enthusiasts discover venues, book playing slots, and connect with local sporting communities.
By integrating KheloMore with KonnexPlay, we're helping venue owners take advantage of that reach without adding another booking calendar to manage manually.
Reach More Players Through the KheloMore Community
One of the biggest challenges for sports venue owners is attracting new customers beyond their existing network.
You might have an excellent facility, but if players don't know it exists, those available slots can remain empty.
Getting your venue listed on KheloMore can help change that.
KheloMore connects venues with people actively searching for sports facilities and playing opportunities in their city.
For a venue owner, this means:
Better online visibility: Help more local players discover your courts or turf.
More booking opportunities: Make your available slots accessible to people looking to book a game.
Access to a growing sports community: Reach players who discover venues through KheloMore's sports booking and community ecosystem.
Potential for repeat customers: Give new players an opportunity to experience your venue and return for future games.
Instead of relying entirely on walk-ins, personal contacts, or WhatsApp enquiries, you can make your venue available to a wider audience of sports enthusiasts.
KheloMore Brings the Players. KonnexPlay Helps Manage the Bookings.
More visibility is great. But more booking channels can also mean more work.
Imagine receiving bookings through different platforms while also handling direct customers, phone enquiries, and walk-ins.
Without a connected system, your staff may need to update availability manually across multiple calendars.
That's time-consuming, and it increases the chances of accidentally accepting two bookings for the same slot.
KonnexPlay is built to solve this problem.
With our completed KheloMore integration, venue owners can manage KheloMore bookings alongside their venue operations through the KonnexPlay sports venue management platform.
Here's what that means for your business:
1. Manage bookings from one place
Instead of switching between different booking platforms throughout the day, keep track of your venue's bookings from a central KonnexPlay dashboard.
2. Keep slot availability synchronized
When a slot is booked, connected availability is updated so that the same slot isn't accidentally sold again through another connected channel.
3. Reduce manual work
Spend less time checking calendars, updating available slots, and coordinating bookings between platforms.
4. Make better use of available slots
A slot that remains empty generates no revenue. Making your venue visible through additional booking channels creates more opportunities to sell those available playing hours.
5. Focus on running your venue
Your staff should be welcoming players and maintaining a great sporting experience, not spending the entire day answering booking enquiries or manually updating calendars.
A Practical Example: Your Pickleball Court on KheloMore
Suppose you operate a pickleball facility with four courts.
Your regular customers usually book evening slots, but several morning and afternoon slots remain available.
By listing your venue on KheloMore, you can potentially reach players who are searching for pickleball courts nearby but haven't heard of your facility.
A player discovers your venue, checks availability, and books a slot through KheloMore.
With KonnexPlay's integration, that booking can be reflected in your central venue calendar, helping you keep track of availability without manually transferring booking information between systems.
Now imagine the same approach across your badminton courts, football turf, or box cricket facility.
More opportunities to get discovered. Less effort managing bookings.
That's the benefit we're working to bring to sports venue owners.
Growing Your Venue Shouldn't Mean More Administrative Work
We believe sports venue owners should be able to grow their businesses without becoming dependent on spreadsheets, multiple booking apps, and constant phone calls.
That's why we're building KonnexPlay as both a sports venue management platform and a channel manager for sports venues in India.
Our goal is to help venue owners increase their online presence, receive bookings across connected channels, and manage their daily operations with less manual effort.
The KheloMore integration is an important step in that direction.
And we're continuing to work toward a more connected sports booking ecosystem.
Already Listed on KheloMore? Let's Connect Your Venue.
If your sports venue is already listed on KheloMore, KonnexPlay can help you bring your booking management into one connected system.
Not listed yet? KheloMore offers venue owners an opportunity to introduce their facilities to players searching for places to play.
With KonnexPlay managing the operational side, you can focus on getting more out of every available slot.
Your venue should be open for bookings, even when you're busy running the business.
